name: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
summary: A cookie carrying sensitive data is readable by script in the browser.

name: Incorrect Access of Indexable Resource ('Range Error')
summary: The product does not restrict an operation to the bounds of a resource.

name: Initialization of a Resource with an Insecure Default
summary: A resource is initialized with a default that is not safe.

name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
summary: The product reads or writes outside the bounds of an allocated buffer.

name: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow')
summary: Input is copied into a buffer without checking that it fits.

name: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
summary: A buffer overflow reaches memory on the call stack.

name: Heap-based Buffer Overflow
summary: A buffer overflow reaches memory on the heap.

name: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File
summary: A field written into a CSV file is interpreted as a formula by a spreadsheet.

name: Out-of-bounds Read
summary: The product reads memory before the start or past the end of a buffer.

name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
summary: An actor writes an attribute on a prototype, changing every object that inherits it.

name: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
summary: A calculation produces a value too large for its type and wraps around.

name: Integer Underflow (Wrap or Wraparound)
summary: A calculation produces a value below the minimum for its type and wraps around.

name: Improper Input Validation
summary: The product does not validate input, or validates it incorrectly.

name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
summary: The product discloses information to an actor not explicitly allowed to have it.

name: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
summary: An error message discloses information useful to an attacker.

name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
summary: A pathname built from input reaches a location outside the intended directory.

name: Improper Privilege Management
summary: The product assigns, keeps or drops privileges incorrectly.

name: Improper Access Control
summary: The product does not restrict access to a resource from an unauthorized actor.

name: Improper Authorization
summary: The product does not check whether an actor may perform the action requested.

name: Improper Authentication
summary: The product does not prove, or incorrectly proves, that an actor is who they claim.

name: Improper Certificate Validation
summary: The product does not validate a certificate, or validates it incorrectly.

name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
summary: A function with serious consequences requires no authentication.

name: Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data
summary: Sensitive data is stored or transmitted with no encryption.

name: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information
summary: Sensitive data is stored where it can be read without decryption.

name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
summary: Sensitive data is sent over a channel that does not encrypt it.

name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
summary: The product uses an algorithm that is no longer considered sound.

name: Use of Insufficiently Random Values
summary: The product uses values that an actor can predict where unpredictability is required.

name: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)
summary: A generator not intended for security is used to produce security-relevant values.

name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
summary: The product acts on a request without verifying the user intended to send it.

name: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition')
summary: Two sequences run concurrently over a shared resource without adequate synchronization.

name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
summary: The state checked is not the state acted on, because it changed in between.

name: Divide By Zero
summary: The product divides by a value it did not check for zero.

name: Insecure Temporary File
summary: A temporary file is created in a way that lets another actor read or replace it.

name: Session Fixation
summary: A session identifier chosen before authentication stays valid after it.

name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
summary: The product does not bound the resources an operation may consume.

name: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime
summary: Memory is not released when it is no longer needed.

name: Improper Resource Shutdown or Release
summary: A resource is not released, or is released incorrectly.

name: Double Free
summary: The same memory is freed twice, corrupting the allocator's state.

name: Use After Free
summary: Memory is used after it has been freed, so its contents are not what the product expects.

name: Direct Request ('Forced Browsing')
summary: A resource is reachable by requesting it directly, bypassing the intended flow.

name: Uncontrolled Search Path Element
summary: The product searches for a resource on a path an attacker can control.

name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
summary: The product accepts an uploaded file whose type lets it be executed or interpreted.

name: Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests ('HTTP Request Smuggling')
summary: Two servers read one request stream differently, so a request is smuggled past one.

name: NULL Pointer Dereference
summary: The product dereferences a pointer it expected to be valid and was not.

name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
summary: The product deserializes data an actor controls without verifying it is valid.

name: Insufficiently Protected Credentials
summary: Credentials are stored or transmitted in a way that lets another actor take them.

name: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
summary: Sensitive data is written to a log that a wider audience can read.

name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
summary: The product acts on a path without checking that a link has not redirected it.

name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
summary: The product redirects to a destination an actor supplies.

name: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
summary: An XML document is parsed with external entity resolution left on.

name: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
summary: A record is retrieved by a key the user supplies, without checking they may see it.

name: Improper Control of a Resource Through its Lifetime
summary: The product does not maintain control over a resource for its whole lifetime.

name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
summary: A resource is made available to a sphere of control that should not reach it.

name: Uncontrolled Recursion
summary: The product recurses without a bound, exhausting the stack.

name: Incorrect Conversion between Numeric Types
summary: A value changes meaning when converted between numeric types.

name: Incorrect Calculation
summary: The product calculates a value incorrectly, often a size or an index.

name: Protection Mechanism Failure
summary: A protection mechanism is absent, applied incorrectly, or can be bypassed.

name: Improper Check or Handling of Exceptional Conditions
summary: The product does not anticipate or handle an exceptional condition.

name: Improper Neutralization
summary: The product does not ensure that input is well formed before it is used.

name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
summary: A resource is created with permissions that let an unintended actor reach it.

name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
summary: Input reaches a downstream component with special elements still intact.

name: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
summary: The product does not check for conditions that occur rarely but do occur.

name: Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions
summary: The product does not handle an exceptional condition once it is detected.

name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
summary: Input is placed into a command without neutralizing it, so the command's meaning changes.

name: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
summary: The product allocates on request without a limit on how much.

name: Improper Restriction of Recursive Entity References in DTDs ('XML Entity Expansion')
summary: An XML document declares entities that expand to exhaust memory or time.

name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
summary: Input is placed into an operating system command without neutralizing it.

name: Out-of-bounds Write
summary: The product writes memory before the start or past the end of a buffer.

name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
summary: Input is placed into a web page without neutralizing it, so a script runs in another user's browser.

name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
summary: Credentials are written into the product, so every installation shares them.

name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
summary: A security decision is made from a value the actor controls.

name: Excessive Iteration
summary: The product loops without an adequate bound on the number of iterations.

name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
summary: A resource is accessed as one type when it holds another.

name: Missing Authorization
summary: The product does not check whether the actor may perform the action at all.

name: Incorrect Authorization
summary: The product checks authorization and reaches the wrong answer.

name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
summary: Input is placed into an SQL statement without neutralizing it, so the statement's meaning changes.

name: Use of Uninitialized Resource
summary: A resource is used before it has been initialized.

name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes
summary: An actor chooses which attributes of an object are written.

name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an Expression Language Statement
summary: Input is placed into an expression language statement without neutralizing it.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
summary: The product fetches a URL an actor supplies, reaching hosts it should not.

name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
summary: Input reaches a facility that turns it into code, so the attacker chooses what runs.
